ch.h:
That world which is all full of your kind

And the one that’s here is a vacuum of time

Watching your steps along the lost line

Covering the grand fall right on time

The distance between me and you is high

The bridge between us is just a big lie

Observing your every move sooths my life

I wish you’d glance at me for now’s the time

The wish that is making its way with a devil’s cry

Like the flamingoes that soar high through the sky

To wish, to join, the fun of your kind

Don’t worry, I’ll be there, it’s just a matter of time.
